text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm overjoyed to receive so
many.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'll decorate my room with them and
send my
parents a picture. Hehe! I have
so many new
friends.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That said, I haven't the space for this
many
plushies in my room.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
They should fit if I rearrange my
furniture and
make more efficient use of
the room's space.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I must return home and take
measurements. This
will be fun.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
